title: A tile still loading shows the loading placeholder, not the chart outline
custom_preconds:
Setup (manual QA tester and Claude session)

Preconditions

  1. User: you are signed in as a user whose role has the Reports permission (for example Admin).
  2. Browser: you use a desktop browser window at least 1024 pixels wide (a maximised laptop or desktop window).
  3. Location: you are in a location (workplace) with nothing in it: no work order, invoice, credit or clocked time (for example ZZAUTOTEST Empty Shop).
custom_steps:
1. Click Dashboard in the top menu with ZZAUTOTEST Empty Shop selected.
  2. Press the browser's reload button and watch the six tiles while the page loads.
  3. On the Revenue tile, open the range pill, pick Last Year and watch the Revenue tile straight away.
  4. Wait until every tile has finished loading and look at the trend-line areas again.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Steps 2 and 3: While a tile is still loading, it shows the loading placeholder in place of its headline, supporting line and trend line. Its name and range pill stay readable. It does not show the dashed outline with the chart icon, and it never shows the previous range's figure.
  • Step 4: Only once the tile has loaded, and has nothing to plot, does the dashed outline with the chart icon appear.
  • Steps 2 and 3: If loading is too quick to see, write 'loading state not seen' in the result comment and pass or fail on the last result.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-490; story SV-9576 (Story 4, KPI Hero Tiles); story SV-9578 (Story 6, Expanding a Tile); Dashboard v1 PRD, Confluence 788430850 v48, read 14 Oct 2026, Story 4 (context note to S4-R12 to S4-E3) and Story 6. Design canvas (claude.ai/artifact/Wae9DFQ8PJQBy8mbLsL5ge, as re-shared and read 14 Oct 2026; a screenshot of the SV-490 build re-shot on 14 Oct 2026) board 15_Empty_After note: "A tile still loading shows the loading placeholder, not this one."

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S4 context note (loading): “the empty-chart placeholder is not the loading placeholder of S6-R14. A tile still loading shows the loading placeholder. A loaded tile with nothing to plot shows the empty-chart placeholder.”
  • S6-R14: “A tile whose figures have not arrived shows a placeholder in place of its headline, supporting line and sparkline, and its label and controls remain readable. The dashboard never shows a blank tile and never shows a stale figure from a previous range while a new one loads.”

Last checked against build v26.40.8-754bd3a on 10/13/2026.
